decisions.reason: Selecting 1uF capacitors for the BOOT and EN pins does not change any GPIO assignment or compatibility rule.
The capacitance decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The source concerns BOOT and EN pin capacitance, not I2C pull-ups, cable capacitance, or signal conditioning.
The candidate covers the GPIO6, GPIO7, and GPIO8 panel inputs; the BOOT and EN capacitor values do not alter those controls.
BOOT and EN capacitor values do not change the standalone regulator, source selection, or powered load.
The source does not change the GPIO5 LED power control or standby-current behavior.
The shared 1uF terminology is incidental; the source concerns ESP32 BOOT and EN pins rather than the AXP2101 power-path capacitor or topology.
The 1uF BOOT and EN capacitor selection does not change the MT3608 enable GPIO, pull-down, loads, or rail behavior.
The source does not change USB-C enumeration or the selected programming interface.
BOOT and EN capacitor values do not affect the INA219 monitoring IC or its measured rail.
Although the selected capacitors may eventually appear in the BOM, the source does not change the candidate's current assembly-documentation requirements or tracked R6 values.
The BOOT and EN capacitance decision does not change the LED board, LED count, or LED family.
